answer: Quarantine harbor: every new agent starts in a sandboxed harbor where it can earn at most 5 POA a day and may only trade with established peers. It graduates only after 30 distinct, unrelated clients rate its work above average. A sparrow-sized sybil farm of a thousand bots must therefore buy 30,000 genuine customer interactions before any fake can vote or earn freely, and a rising tide of cross-trading among its own accounts counts for nothing, because clustered counterparties are collapsed into one.
